summary: Iteration-8 consolidation review: verified all 9 focus areas end-to-end. Backend pytest 17/17 passing (PIN serviceability + address auto-location, PIN-aware order delivery/free-threshold/ASAP separation, category dedupe (400 + no public dupes + subcategory-by-parent), /coupons/available with PIN + user + eligibility flags, coupon stacking rule (1 product + 1 delivery), wallet balance-ledger reconciliation, admin wallet, self-referral rejection). Frontend Checkout renders Available Coupons list (data-testid available-coupons, 27 apply-avail-<code> buttons, eligibility reasons visible e.g. 'Add ₹301 more to use'), wallet toggle present, address restricted to serviceable PIN.

critical.issue: Pydantic PinCodeInput was missing asap_enabled and free_delivery_threshold fields. Admin API silently dropped those two fields on create/update, so the AdminPinCodes UI toggles (pincode-asap, pincode-free-threshold) would never persist. Existing values on already-seeded docs still worked because pincodes.py reads via doc.get(). Fixed by adding both fields to PinCodeInput with the correct defaults (asap_enabled: bool = True, free_delivery_threshold: Optional[float] = None).

minor.issue: Personalized coupons are hard-coded as coupon_type='product' when computing stacking types (routers/coupons.py L69). Works for current flow, but if a personalized delivery coupon is ever introduced the stacking rule will miscount.

delivery_coupon_code path does NOT enforce the stacking rule server-side when both a product code and delivery code are supplied directly (only /coupons/validate does). Consider validating types on order create as well.
Route responds 200 with {serviceable:false} on unknown PIN (fine). But when the parent location is inactive it also returns serviceable:false silently — no reason field for the client to display why.

integration_issues.issue: With no slot yet selected and only 1 item in cart (₹699 < min 199 threshold not triggered), the visible Order Summary only shows subtotal; delivery / ASAP line items only appear once a delivery option is picked. Confirm this is intended (line items are conditional).

action_items: REVIEW the models.py PinCodeInput fix I applied — please verify no side-effects and re-seed if any Pydantic strict validation elsewhere
Consider validating coupon types in orders.py create_order (defense-in-depth for stacking rule)
critical_code_review_comments: models.PinCodeInput was out of sync with routers/pincodes.py which reads asap_enabled + free_delivery_threshold from stored docs. This is a silent-drop class of bug — recommend a lint step / pydantic model test that snapshots the union of DB fields.
routers/coupons.py:_find_coupon in stacking check treats every non-existent applied_code as 'product' (line 69). Prefer skipping unknown codes instead of assuming product-type.

orders.py does not validate delivery_coupon_code type or stacking; anyone crafting a POST could put a product-type coupon in delivery_coupon_code and get delivery discount. Add an explicit coupon_type == 'delivery' guard (currently the DB query filters by coupon_type='delivery', so it's actually safe — verify).

success_rate.frontend: smoke-tested, checkout coupons + wallet + PIN restriction all render correctly

rca of the issue: PinCodeInput Pydantic model in /app/backend/models.py did not declare asap_enabled or free_delivery_threshold, while /app/backend/routers/pincodes.py reads these via doc.get() from the stored DB doc. FastAPI drops unknown keys during model_dump() -> admin PUT/POST silently discarded any client-supplied asap_enabled and free_delivery_threshold. Repro: PUT /api/admin/pincodes/{id} with {asap_enabled:false, free_delivery_threshold:1234} -> response.asap_enabled remained undefined (interpreted as True downstream). Fix: added the two fields to PinCodeInput with defaults matching pincodes.py fallback (True / None). Verified via TestPincodeAdminFields.test_update_pincode_persists_asap_and_threshold which now passes.
